Hi Anu / Mike —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock in the engineering deep review: 

- Goal: 60–75 minute technical run-through (architecture, integrations, data flow, perf targets).
- Outcomes: confirm infra requirements, sample data access, and a mutual action plan for a short pilot.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Wed 2027-06-15 10:00–11:15
- Thu 2027-06-16 09:00–10:15
- Fri 2027-06-17 13:00–14:15

Can you confirm which of these works and who from your side will attend (names + roles)? Also tell us whether you prefer Zoom or Google Meet for the session — we can host either.

I've attached the discovery notes from today's call and a starter M.A.P. (mutual-action-plan) we'll iterate on. Once we have the slot and attendee list, I'll send the calendar invite with the meeting link and assign owners on our side: Diego will lead the infra/ops portion and Priyom will run through the integration checklist.

Attachments: [Attachment: discovery-notes.pdf (pdf, 160KB)]

Thanks,
Jonas Weber

Jonas — I can take that. I'll prepare a focused 20-min segment covering:
- Runtime architecture (request routing, KV cache behavior)
- Batching and latency tradeoffs (examples from a 2k-token workload)
- Deployment topology and quantization recommendations for your expected throughput

Prereqs for demo:
- Access to a small sample dataset (S3 link or sanitized extract) — Priya Suresh should be able to share.
- Allowlist IP for our staging host (I can provide the IPs once we confirm the slot).
- If you want kernel-level profiling, please confirm we can SSH to a test node (read-only).

I'll drop a short runbook into the shared drive and add a slide for the agenda.
